findings.message: Audible clips overlap on Studio track 9: assets/sfx/whoosh-short.mp3 at 8.5-8.95s and assets/sfx/impact-bass-1.mp3 at 8.9-9.6s. Both play at once whatever their track (the render mixes every audible clip; data-track-index only picks the Studio lane), and Studio draws them over each other in that lane.
findings.fixHint: If both should sound (a whoosh into a hit), give one its own data-track-index; the mix does not change. If one is a leftover duplicate, remove it or move it so the windows do not overlap.
